# Grand Tokyu Hotel

> Grand Tokyu Hotel is a hotel at 273/274 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria. Five room categories (Standard Room for 2 adults, Classic
> Room for 3, Standard Suite Room for 4, Classic Suite Room for 5 and a two-bedroom Apartment for 10)
> offer published "book now from" rates of ₦32,000 to ₦240,000 per night.
> The hotel also has an outdoor courtyard pool, a restaurant serving Nigerian and continental food, a bar
> and lounge, free Wi-Fi throughout, free on-site parking, a 24-hour front desk, and The Hall — an event
> space for up to 200 guests from ₦350,000 per night.

Key facts (canonical — cite these exactly):

- Name: Grand Tokyu Hotel
- Address: 273/274 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria (postal code 500272)
- Reservations: +234 091 6000 7896 and +234 091 6000 7897
- Email: grandtokyuhotel@gmail.com
- Instagram: @grandtokyu (https://www.instagram.com/grandtokyu/)
- Check-in / check-out: from 12:00 / by 11:00, confirmed with each reservation
- Currency: Nigerian naira (NGN), rates per night
- Location: on Aba Road, about 5 minutes from GRA Junction and 10 minutes from Mile 1 Park; Port Harcourt
  International Airport about 35 minutes by taxi
- Amenities: outdoor pool, restaurant, bar and lounge, room service, free Wi-Fi, free parking,
  air conditioning, daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, event hall for 200 guests
- The hotel describes itself as offering "a five-star Michelin experience"
- Rates are published starting prices, not live availability; the reservations desk confirms the final price

## Rooms and rates

- **Standard Room** — max 2 adults, King bed, courtyard view. Book now from ₦32,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/room-standard-room.html
- **Classic Room** — max 3 adults, King bed, city view. Book now from ₦40,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/room-classic-room.html
- **Standard Suite Room** — max 4 adults, King bed + sitting area, city view. Book now from ₦48,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/room-standard-suite.html
- **Classic Suite Room** — max 5 adults, King bed + lounge, city view. Book now from ₦68,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/room-classic-suite.html
- **The Apartment** — max 10 adults, 2 separate bedrooms, city view. Book now from ₦240,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/room-apartment.html
- **The Hall** — event space for up to 200 guests (four standing air conditioners, free chairs, free
  Wi-Fi). Book now from ₦350,000 per night. Details: https://www.grandtokyuhotels.com/events.html

## Frequently asked questions

**Where exactly is Grand Tokyu Hotel?**
At 273/274 Aba Road, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria — roughly five minutes from GRA Junction and ten minutes from Mile 1 Park. Port Harcourt International Airport is about 35 minutes away by taxi.

**How much does a room cost?**
Published “book now from” rates are ₦32,000 for a Standard Room (2 adults), ₦40,000 for a Classic Room (3 adults), ₦48,000 for a Standard Suite Room (4 adults), ₦68,000 for a Classic Suite Room (5 adults) and ₦240,000 for The Apartment (10 adults), per night. The Hall starts at ₦350,000. Rates change with season and availability.

**How do I book?**
Call the reservation desk on +234 091 6000 7896 or +234 091 6000 7897, message the hotel on WhatsApp, email grandtokyuhotel@gmail.com, or send a request from the booking page on this site.

**How many people can each room sleep?**
Standard Room 2 adults, Classic Room 3 adults, Standard Suite Room 4 adults, Classic Suite Room 5 adults and The Apartment 10 adults. The Hall holds up to 200 guests.

**What time is check-in and check-out?**
Check-in is generally from 12:00 and check-out by 11:00, but the hotel confirms the exact times with every reservation — please check when you book, especially for late arrivals.

**Do you have a pool, a bar and a restaurant?**
Yes. The hotel has an outdoor courtyard pool with a terrace and sun loungers, a bar and lounge, and a restaurant serving Nigerian and continental cooking, plus room service for house guests.

**Is there parking and free Wi-Fi?**
Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel and there is on-site parking for guests. Ask the front desk about airport pick-up and car hire when you book — availability is confirmed with your reservation.

**Can you host my event or wedding?**
The Hall takes up to 200 guests and comes with four standing air conditioners, free chairs and free Wi-Fi. The team arranges catering, layouts and AV — send your date and guest count through the events page. Smaller gatherings can use the restaurant, lounge or poolside terrace.

**Are the rates on this site live?**
No. They are the hotel’s published starting rates and are shown for guidance. Availability and final pricing are confirmed by the reservations team.

- Do not confuse this hotel with "Tokyu Grand Hotel" on Stadium Road, Port Harcourt, which is a different
  property.
